canonical_title: Ema raises $77M Series B for enterprise AI employees
treatment: Covered as an enterprise-agent adoption and financing signal. Repeat only for material product architecture, verified adoption metrics, major customer expansion, pricing changes, or another significant financing/transaction delta.
known_facts: Ema raised $77 million in a Series B led by Creaegis, bringing total funding to $140 million.
Ema coordinates multiple AI agents across enterprise workflows in HR, IT, and finance and can draw on more than 150 models.
Ema says it has more than 1 million active enterprise users, more than 50 active enterprise deals, over $150 million in multiyear bookings, and around 180% net dollar retention.
Pricing is tied to completed tasks and business outcomes rather than seats or token consumption.
reinclude_only_if: Material verified adoption or revenue metric changes practical interpretation.
Major product architecture, model-routing, pricing, or enterprise deployment change.
New major financing, acquisition, or strategic transaction.
notes: TechCrunch published at 5:00 AM PDT / 21:00 JST, inside the Night window. Company announcement was 9:00 AM EDT / 22:00 JST.
